title: Profile shift can lead to missing profile values
symptom: When performing a profile shift for 2 hours, the target becomes 5 for the whole day starting from 9:00, and the second range of '02:00 to 09:00' disappears, with its value moved to the third range.
fix: The issue was reported to be fixed in version 3.1-beta; the maintainer states it will be released soon.
evidence_quote: only could check 3.1-beta in emulator - works fine there.
